text:
Dana (Procurement, Skylane): Hi, we received invoice INV-2026-078 but our procurement policy requires an official PO before any final invoice can be processed. We can't accept this as a payable invoice without a PO number.
Sara (Support): Thanks for flagging — sorry for the hassle. Can you confirm the exact legal entity name and the billing contact/email so we can issue a pro forma?
Dana (Procurement, Skylane): Legal name: Skylane Health Inc. Billing contact: procure@skylanehealth.com. We also need the cost center and GL code fields on the pro forma so our system can create a PO.
Sara (Support): Got it. @James can you confirm the approved amount and SOW/ref so Finance can draft a pro forma?
James (Account Exec): Yep — total for the quarter is $42,000 USD, SOW ref: SOW-314-Redwood. Pricing is the standard committed-rate in the contract. I'll stand by if Finance needs anything else.
Lucas (Finance): We can issue a pro forma. We'll include fields: Company name, billing address, VAT/Tax ID, cost center, GL code, PO placeholder. What is Skylane's VAT ID (if applicable) and desired billing address?
Dana (Procurement, Skylane): VAT ID: US-98-7654321. Billing address: 221 Market St, Suite 600, San Francisco, CA 94105. Cost center: CC-7421. GL code: 5400-22.
Lucas (Finance): Perfect — creating pro forma now. I'll upload a PDF to this thread once ready. Payment terms on the pro forma will be Net 30 and we'll note "Final invoice issued upon receipt of customer PO".
billing-bot: Uploaded file: proforma_INV-2026-078_skylane_2026-03-14.pdf
Sara (Support): Attached the file above. Quick preview: ```Pro Forma: INV-PRO-2026-078
Bill To: Skylane Health Inc.
VAT: US-98-7654321
Amount: $42,000.00 USD
Currency: USD
Cost center: CC-7421
GL: 5400-22
Due: 2026-04-13
Notes: Final invoice will be issued after receipt of official PO (PO number required).```
Dana (Procurement, Skylane): This looks good. Will route to our AP and create PO today — expect PO number by EOD. We can send either a PO PDF or just the PO number via email. Which is preferred?
Lucas (Finance): Either is fine. If you email a PO PDF, please cc billing@redwood-inference.com so we can attach it to the invoice record. If sending only a PO number, include the PO format (e.g., PO-XXXXX) and the company that issued it.
Sara (Support): For speed, you can also paste the PO number here and we'll mark it on our side. Billing email is billing@redwood-inference.com.
Dana (Procurement, Skylane): Thanks — I'll send the PO PDF to billing@redwood-inference.com and copy procure@skylanehealth.com.
James (Account Exec): Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with Dana offline to unblock their AP if needed. @Lucas once you receive the PO can you confirm and convert pro forma -> final invoice?
Lucas (Finance): Will do. Once PO is attached to the account record we'll issue INV-2026-078 as the final invoice and send to Skylane's AP.
Sara (Support): Closing loop here — leaving the thread open until the PO arrives. :white_check_mark:
Dana (Procurement, Skylane): Sent PO PDF to billing@redwood-inference.com just now, subject "Skylane PO 2026-5512". Please confirm when you receive it.
Lucas (Finance): Received the PDF and PO# 2026-5512. Converting pro forma to final invoice now, will post update when sent.
Sara (Support): Thanks team — marking as resolved after Lucas confirms the final invoice dispatch. :thumbsup:
